purpose: Check one measured property from a native-reopen observation against an expected value and artifact digest.
trigger: Use when a measured native-reopen observation, expected value, artifact SHA-256, and any tolerance are available.

inputs.name: observation
inputs.description: Positional caller-supplied measured property record from an already completed native_reopen observation; this helper does not obtain it.

inputs.name: expected_value
inputs.description: Positional expected finite scalar, nonempty text, boolean, or nonempty flat finite numeric vector.

inputs.name: expected_artifact_sha256
inputs.description: Positional expected hash of the reopened native artifact.

inputs.name: absolute_tolerance
inputs.description: Keyword-only absolute_tolerance; optional and defaults to 0.0; must be finite and nonnegative.

inputs.name: action_id
inputs.description: Keyword-only action_id; optional for this contract because the host default is exactly VA-23.

preconditions: Call check_observed_property(observation, expected_value, expected_artifact_sha256, *, absolute_tolerance=0.0, action_id='VA-23'); the first three arguments are positional and the final two are keyword-only.
observation source_kind is native_reopen and status is measured.
expected_artifact_sha256 is a valid SHA-256 digest and action_id, when supplied, is VA-23.
The caller supplies property, object_identity, observation_ref, artifact hash, and one supported value type; the helper does not reopen or measure an artifact.

outputs.name: actual
outputs.description: Observed property value copied from the caller-supplied flat observation.

outputs.name: expected
outputs.description: Expected property value compared with the caller-supplied observation.

outputs.name: artifact_sha256
outputs.description: Expected reopened artifact hash echoed after artifact binding.

outputs.name: runtime_observed
outputs.description: Always false; host helper does not observe SpaceClaim.

postconditions: Exactly one supplied property is compared within absolute_tolerance.
runtime_observed=false and no native_reopen runtime observation is claimed.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host-side Python helper; it compares one caller-supplied observation and never opens or controls SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: Call validation_host_actions.check_observed_property(observation, expected_value, expected_artifact_sha256, absolute_tolerance=..., action_id='VA-23'). The first three arguments are positional and the final two are keyword-only. The native_reopen observation is caller-supplied; invalid inputs raise ValidationInputError, a ValueError subclass, and no reopen, measurement, or geometry check is performed here.

ambiguity_checks: This host helper does not select or reopen CAD objects; the caller must supply one explicit observation identity and artifact hash.
If the native_reopen observation cannot be independently obtained, return needs_manual_review rather than invoke the comparison with guessed values.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The action ID/source kind, observation fields, artifact digest, tolerance, or value representation is invalid.
failure_modes.detection: check_observed_property raises ValidationInputError, which is a ValueError subclass.
failure_modes.safe_state: No reopen or runtime claim is emitted; preserve the host-only boundary and return needs_manual_review to the caller.

failure_modes.condition: The supplied observed property is outside absolute_tolerance from expected_value.
failure_modes.detection: The helper returns a flat result with status=failed; it does not acquire another measurement.
failure_modes.safe_state: Retain the failed comparison and do not promote native_reopen or geometry evidence.

recovery.action: Catch ValidationInputError/ValueError, obtain or correct the caller-supplied native_reopen record, and retry only with explicit evidence; otherwise return needs_manual_review.
Inspect the independent reopened measurement and expected value; do not coerce tolerance or treat a failed comparison as runtime success.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare its operation ID with the catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, candidate-only, and declares one independent validation_visual_review action.

validation.method: Compare the positional/keyword-only host-call interface, flat result fields, and ValidationInputError/ValueError boundary with the linked guidance file.
validation.expected: The contract exposes the same fields and preserves needs_manual_review, unsupported-control, and no-overclaim boundaries.

validation.method: Call validation_host_actions.check_observed_property(observation, expected_value, expected_artifact_sha256, absolute_tolerance=..., action_id='VA-23') only after the caller has independently obtained the native_reopen observation.
validation.expected: Exactly one supplied property is compared within absolute_tolerance.

evidence_level.notes: Deterministic host property/file checks only. Caller must independently provide trustworthy measured/runtime observations.
